answer: The vine counter is kept in zephyr and saffron reveals each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 138 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
